g.text: Food Rescue Platform (Replate) - Algorithmic Matching Decision Flow
Extract Pickup Coordinates, Food Category, Quantity (kg), and Expiry Time
Query Database for all Approved NGOs
Is current IST time within NGO operating_hours?
Calculate Haversine Distance between Donor & NGO
Emit alert to Operations & Queue for radius expansion retry
Fetch Active Weights for (City, Food Category) from MatchingWeightsHistory
Sort candidates in descending order of Total Score
Select Candidate with Highest Total Score
Transmit Match Offer to Matched NGO via WebSocket & Push Notification
Trigger automated rematch with remaining eligible NGOs
